scenes.text: Today's AI has a genius brain and a goldfish memory. Hippocampus is the fix. Condensed memory for AI agents.
Most memory layers grow without limit. Vectors pile up. Retrieval gets noisier. And the model still misses what matters.
Hippocampus is a different path. One memory string per user. Your model writes it. Your model reads it. No vectors. No pipelines.
Every conversation makes it smarter. Hippocampus learns each user's preferences, context, and goals — automatically. Your agent stops repeating itself. It starts learning.
Four methods. Add. Get. Delete. Close. That is the entire SDK.
Drops in anywhere — SQLite, Redis, S3, or your own callback.
Powered by NeuroLink. Every provider. Every model. Your choice.

On LoCoMo, the long-conversation memory benchmark, Hippocampus hits ninety-five percent on adversarial. It knows when it does not know. Seventy-eight percent on single-hop recall. Sixty-five percent overall. From a memory thirty times smaller than the source.
Five thousand turns of dialogue. Compressed into a single prompt your model reads in one pass.
Already in production at Juspay — powering Tara, Breeze Automatic, and Yamma.
Every chatbot, every agent, every AI in your stack needs memory. Hippocampus is the simplest one that works.
Hippocampus. By Juspay. npm install at-juspay-slash-hippocampus.
